text:
### Mission  
Provide legal counsel and manage regulatory affairs.
name: Chunk 85/102

raw_entities.name: Legal and Regulatory Affairs Function
raw_entities.description: Internal department responsible for providing legal counsel to the organization and managing all regulatory affairs matters. This function serves as the primary interface between FirstUK Bank and regulatory bodies.
context: Provide legal counsel and manage regulatory affairs

raw_entities.name: Legal Counsel Provision Obligation
raw_entities.description: The bank is obligated to maintain a function that provides legal counsel to support business operations and ensure compliance with legal requirements.
context: Provide legal counsel and manage regulatory affairs

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Affairs Management Obligation
raw_entities.description: The bank is obligated to actively manage regulatory affairs, serving as the primary point of coordination with regulatory authorities and ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements.
context: Provide legal counsel and manage regulatory affairs
